findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed soda gun nozzle at bar to be soiled with debris and mold. Soda gun nozzle was cleaned and sanitized during inspection. 

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed interior of ice machine to be soiled with mold and debris. Clean and sanitize interior of ice machine.

 4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment: Observed the drop guard of the ice machine to be soiled with mold. The drop guard has been cleaned. 4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: Observed a slimy mold to be growing in the soda gun holder.  The soda gun holder was cleaned immediately. 4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment: This is a low risk facility and does not require a food manager. The computer is making me place this violation.

findings.title: Dishwashing facilities designed, constructed, operated (1. wash 2. rinse 3. sanitize)
findings.comment: The facility operated the 3 part sink as wash, sanitize and the 3rd part is used as a dump sink. Use the 3 part properly by wash, rinse, and sanitize for one minute in the 3rd part sink. A 5 gallon bucket may be utilized for a dump sink.  750-820a For manual washing, rinsing and sanitizing of utensils and equipment, a sink with no fewer then three compartments shall be provided and used.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment: Upon arrival a wet wiping cloth is observed to be sitting on the bar top not in sanitizer. Store wet wiping cloths properly in sanitizer bucket. 750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping shall be clean and stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: Observed the pizza ovens and the ice machine drop guard to be soiled. The pizza ovens are used heavily on Wednesday nights according to employee. The drop guard is soiled with mold.  Properly clean and maintain free of accumulated soil. 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use. |

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: Observed single use plates to be stored eating surfaces up and straws to be stored unprotected on the bar top. Store single use items inverted and protected. 750-880 Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: Back kitchen area is missing ceiling tiles. Replace ceiling tiles. 750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.citation_text:
750.1120 - Heavy mold accumulation was observed inside the ice machine on and around the drip guard. Some mold was observed on spots along the inner walls by the door as well. It was difficult to see behind the metal baffle, but there appeared to be mold accumulation on the ceiling behind the baffle. Employee cleaned the metal baffle,  surfaces around the baffle, and the inner walls by the door during the inspection. Layers of ice were removed after cleaning occurred. 
Employee was advised a call for service needs to be made to Crowder to check other areas of the machine and conduct a through cleaning. 

Foods and food contact surfaces shall be protected from potential cross contamination at all times.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.citation_text:
750.290 - Ice scoop was observed with handle down inside touching the ice. Store ice scoops with handles extended up out of ice.

Ice scoops shall be stored on a clean surface or in ice with the handle extended up.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
750.800e - The drip trays of pizza ovens and counter beneath the pizza ovens were soiled with food splash/debris.

Clean the drip trays and counter under the pizza ovens daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.citation_text:
750.1100 - Drain line beneath ice bin had a connection where a drip was present. Dripping water was landing around the back right leg of the ice bin where significant water damage was present. Repair the drain line to eliminate leaking.

Drain lines from equipment shall not discharge waste water in such a manner as will permit the flooding of floors or the flowing of water across working or walking areas or into difficult-to-clean areas, or otherwise create a nuisance.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.citation_text:
750.1120 - Paper towels were not observed at designated handwashing sink in the back room. 

Maintain soap and paper towels at the designated handsink to allow for proper handwashing.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.citation_text:
750.1160 - A) House flies were observed in the window by the pool table (7), the window by the ATM machine (3), at the front door (1), and in the window behind the bar (1). All but a few of the flies were removed from the premises by use of a vacuum.

B) Fruit fly larvae (7) and one pupa (stage between larvae and adult fruit fly) were observed in the soda gun holder. Holder was cleaned and sanitized during the inspection.

Effective measures to minimize the presence of pests shall be utilized. Provide effective pest control.
**Fly strips may be used in the facility as long as they are placed in appropriate locations away from food, food equipment, clean glasses, and single service items. Fly strips may be placed in windows and around doors at close of business to help minimize presence of flies.
**Clean and sanitize the soda gun and holder as needed to eliminate food/water source for fruit flies.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text:
750.1200 - A) Floor was damaged in front of the back door leading to the back parking lot.

B) Corner of floor was loose in front of the bar 3 part sink.

C) Wood was warped and water damaged under the bar ice bin, especially on the far left side of the floor board and around the back right leg of the ice bin.
Make proper repairs in the aforementioned areas.

Floors must be in good repair, constructed to facilitate easy cleaning, and maintained clean.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.citation_text:
750.830 - Chlorine test were not available for checking concentration of bleach solutions. If a bleach solution is too weak it is not properly sanitizing surfaces, and if a bleach solution is too strong then it is toxic. Obtain and use chlorine test strips. A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.
50ppm = bleach solution concentration for 3rd compartment at 3 part sink
100ppm = bleach solution concentration for spray bottles and buckets for wiping general surfaces

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - Mold was observed inside ice machine on and around the drip guard. Owner leases machine and called Crowder during inspection to verify when service is due. Owner noted Crowder should be out in the next couple days for full service, and Crowder employee arrived during inspection to service the machine. Clean and sanitize surfaces inside the ice machine that can be accessed between services. Food contact surfaces shall be cleaned and sanitized between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of mold and debris.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.citation_text: 750.1170 - Light was visible at the back door where door has started to rust out at the bottom and weather stripping is missing at the top. Make necessary repairs to the back door so it is tight fitting and vermin proof. Check all outer doors and windows and make repairs where necessary. Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1210 & 1220 - A) WALKIN COOLER: 1. Walls, ceiling, and fan covers were soiled. Clean inside the walkin cooler. 2.
